# Ban Lãnh Đạo — Investigation Report (evidence-backed) ## Executive summary Generated repo artifacts (`SectionBanLanhDao.css.inc`, SQL seed, template) **match** canonical `output/style.css` after scoping. Visual drift on HOS is **not** from stale seed HTML, but from **CSS delivery architecture**: dual CSS layers (static `.css.inc` + DB `CssText`), CMS builder saving **GrapesJS overrides only**, TiemChung-fork leftovers in the builder (wrong font picker / `tc-*` theme classes), and global HOS `style.css` winning when scoped CSS is missing or overridden. The 6 canonical sections are present once in seed HTML — “multiple blocks” is likely **CMS block UX** or **missing hero styling**, not duplicate SQL sections. --- ## 1. Canonical source vs pipeline input | Asset | Path | Role | |---|---|---| | Standalone preview | `g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\z.Source-mẫu\banlanhdaoj\output\index.html` | `
` only; links external `style.css` + `script.js` | | CSS canonical | `g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\z.Source-mẫu\banlanhdaoj\output\style.css` | `:root` vars, unscoped selectors, `--primary: #0D7A3E`, Lexend/Be Vietnam Pro | | JS canonical | `g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\z.Source-mẫu\banlanhdaoj\output\script.js` | `.reveal` IntersectionObserver | | Full HTML source | `g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\z.Source-mẫu\banlanhdaoj\Ban_Lanh_Dao.html` | Same `
` content as `index.html` (lines 394–410 hero match lines 19–35 of index) | **Important:** generator reads HTML from `Ban_Lanh_Dao.html`, CSS from `output/style.css` — not `index.html` directly, but `
` content is equivalent. ```12:14:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\tools\generate-banlanhdao-fullpage-seed.js var sourcePath = path.join(root, 'z.Source-m\u1eabu', 'banlanhdaoj', 'Ban_Lanh_Dao.html'); var cssPath = path.join(root, 'z.Source-m\u1eabu', 'banlanhdaoj', 'output', 'style.css'); ``` Metadata correctly points at `output/`: ```1:12:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\SQL\CHUYENDOI\BanLanhDao\_project_json_metadata.json { "pageCode": "BAN_LANH_DAO", "source": "z.Source-mẫu/banlanhdaoj/output", ... "sections": [ "leadership-hero", "management-section", ... ] } ``` --- ## 2. End-to-end pipeline trace ``` Canonical output/style.css → tools/scope-css.js (.ban-lanh-dao-page) → generate-banlanhdao-fullpage-seed.js ├─ SQL/CHUYENDOI/BanLanhDao/02_...Insert_NoiDungHienTai.sql (HtmlBody + CssText) ├─ HOS/.../SectionBanLanhDao.css.inc (base, +@import fonts) ├─ HOS/.../SectionBanLanhDao.template.inc (fallback/import HTML) └─ CMS/.../ban-lanh-dao-page-base.css.inc (builder canvas base) Canonical Ban_Lanh_Dao.html
→ wrapped in .ban-lanh-dao-page > .ban-lanh-dao-page-body → stored as CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion.HtmlBodyVi HOS live page (SectionBanLanhDao.ascx) → CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetPublished → renders FullPageHtml + optional FullPageCss CMS builder (ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js) → baseCss injected in iframe only (from ban-lanh-dao-page-base.css.inc) → save publishes editor.getCss() as CssText (GrapesJS overrides, NOT full base) ``` ### SQL → DB `02_CMS_BanLanhDaoFullPage_Insert_NoiDungHienTai.sql` stores **full scoped CSS** (no `@import`) in `CssText`, plus wrapped HTML. Seed fragment has exactly **6 sections**, **1 wrapper** — no duplicate hero/management in repo artifacts: ```1:24:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\SQL\CHUYENDOI\BanLanhDao\_html_seed_fragment.txt
...
``` ### HOS frontend ```4:14:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\HOS\Controls\Information\BanLanhDao\SectionBanLanhDao.ascx <% if (HasFullPage && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FullPageCss)) { %> <% } %> ``` CSS load order on HOS: **(1) fonts link → (2) base-style → (3) cms-style**. Later block wins on equal specificity. Code-behind loads DB HTML, sanitizes, deduplicates nested wrappers (`NormalizeBanLanhDaoShell` lines 166–181 in `SectionBanLanhDao.ascx.cs`). ### CMS builder On **import**: `state.css = ''`; full styling from `baseCss` only (lines 1493–1504 in `ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js`). On **save**: ```1306:1312:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\CMS\Controls\3Landing\BanLanhDao\ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js state[currentLanguage].html = ensureShell(editor.getHtml()); ... state.css = scopeCss(editor.getCss() || ''); ``` ```1673:1676:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\CMS\Controls\3Landing\BanLanhDao\ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js HtmlBodyVi: state.vi.html, ... CssText: state.css || '', ``` **CssText ≠ canonical CSS.** It is only GrapesJS Style Manager / inline overrides. Unedited import → empty `CssText` → HOS depends entirely on `.css.inc`. --- ## 3. Root causes (mapped to reported symptoms) ### RC-1 — Dual CSS split + override order (primary color/typography drift) | Layer | Source | Content | |---|---|---| | `#ban-lanh-dao-page-base-style` | `SectionBanLanhDao.css.inc` (SSI) | Full scoped canonical CSS | | `#ban-lanh-dao-page-cms-style` | DB `CssText` | Seed: duplicate full CSS; post-CMS-save: partial/empty overrides | - SQL seed duplicates full CSS into DB **and** `.css.inc` (generator lines 122–123, 270–275). - After CMS import + publish, `CssText` is often **empty** — page relies on SSI `.css.inc`. - Any GrapesJS edit writes **partial** rules into `CssText`, which loads **after** base and overrides canonical colors/fonts. **Matches wrong screenshot:** grey/plain headings, no green `em`, no cream hero — scoped rules absent or overridden. ### RC-2 — CMS builder still carries TiemChung DNA (font + theme corruption) Forked via `generate-banlanhdao-cms-files.js` / `generate-banlanhdao-builder-js.js` but **not fully adapted**: **Style Manager fonts** still Open Sans / Montserrat (TiemChung defaults): ```828:838:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\CMS\Controls\3Landing\BanLanhDao\ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js options: [ { id: 'var(--body-font)', label: 'Open Sans · Nội dung' }, { id: 'var(--title-font)', label: 'Montserrat · Tiêu đề' }, ... ] ``` **Theme traits** expose `tc-bg-*`, `tc-vaccine-panel`, etc. (lines 210–438) — **none exist** in BanLanhDao CSS (grep: zero matches in `HOS/Controls/Information/BanLanhDao` and `ban-lanh-dao-page-base.css.inc`). Applying these in CMS adds classes with **no stylesheet rules**. Vaccine-tab handlers (`activateVaccineTabInDoc`, lines 933–1000) are dead TiemChung code — harmless visually but signals incomplete fork. ### RC-3 — Global HOS CSS cascade when scoped CSS fails `BDS.Master` always loads `/assets/css/style.css` **before** page content: ```72:77:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\HOS\BDS.Master ... ``` Global rules affect unscoped elements: ```215:227:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\HOS\assets\css\style.css .h1, h1, .h2, h2, ... .page-title, .section-title, .card-title { color: #017A48; font-weight: 600; ... } .h1, h1 { font-size: var(--fs-h1); } ``` Canonical hero needs `.ban-lanh-dao-page .leadership-hero h1` (specificity 0,3,1) and `h1 em { color: var(--primary) }`. If `.css.inc` does not load, global `h1` + browser default `em` italic produce **wrong colors/typography** — consistent with reported drift. ### RC-4 — SSI `#include` dependency for base CSS Base CSS is injected via IIS SSI, not code-behind: ```5:7:g:\0.DỰ ÁN\WWEB-TAM-DUC\HOS\Controls\Information\BanLanhDao\SectionBanLanhDao.ascx ``` No `enableServerSideInclude` found in repo `web.config`. If IIS SSI is off, `#ban-lanh-dao-page-base-style` is **empty** unless DB `CssText` compensates. Same pattern as TiemChung/About — environment-dependent. ### RC-5 — Scoping transform (working as designed, not a bug) `tools/scope-css.js` maps `:root` → `.ban-lanh-dao-page` (line 62). Generated `.css.inc` defines vars on `.ban-lanh-dao-page` (lines 4–23). Equivalent to canonical when wrapper exists. ### RC-6 — “Multiple blocks” (not duplicate seed sections) Repo seed has **one** wrapper, **six** intentional sections (hero, management, closing, board, disclosure, letterhead). Not a SQL duplication bug. Likely interpretations: 1. **By design:** hero + management heading visible in one viewport (matches wrong screenshot layout). 2. **CMS UX:** builder exposes 9 palette blocks (`bld-hero` … `bld-image`, lines 187–196) — rebuilding from blocks yields stub content, not full canonical page. 3. **Wrapper nesting:** import/save can double-wrap; mitigated by `NormalizeBanLanhDaoShell` in HOS handler (lines 410–425) and builder `sanitizeLoadedHtml` (lines 47–56). Check live DB with `02_CMS_BanLanhDaoFullPage_KiemTra.sql` column `WrapperVi`. **Eyebrow dash confusion:** canonical hero uses CSS `::before` green line (no literal dash); closing section uses literal `—` in content (`SectionBanLanhDao.template.inc` line 68). Without CSS, both read as plain dashed labels — can look like “wrong block style.” --- ## 4. Canonical vs deployed — what matches | Item | Status | |---|---| | HTML structure (6 sections, hero `h1` with `Lãnh Đạo`) | Match in `_html_seed_fragment.txt` / `.template.inc` | | Color tokens (`#0D7A3E`, `#FBF8F4` cream hero) | Match in scoped `.css.inc` | | Hero layout (absolute `.hero-media`, cream bg) | Rules present lines 47–65 of `.css.inc` | | JS reveal behavior | `SectionBanLanhDao.js` mirrors `output/script.js`, scoped to `[data-ban-lanh-dao-root]` | | Fonts | Explicit Lexend + Be Vietnam Pro link in ascx; canonical uses same | --- ## 5. Files to regenerate vs manually fix ### Regenerate (run generators + re-apply SQL) | Command / action | Outputs | |---|---| | `node tools/generate-banlanhdao-fullpage-seed.js` | `02_CMS_BanLanhDaoFullPage_Insert_NoiDungHienTai.sql`, `_html_seed_fragment.txt`, `_style_*.css`, `_project_json_metadata.json`, `SectionBanLanhDao.css.inc`, `SectionBanLanhDao.template.inc`, `ban-lanh-dao-page-base.css.inc` | | Re-run SQL `02_...Insert_NoiDungHienTai.sql` on DB | Published version with fresh HtmlBody + CssText | | `node tools/generate-banlanhdao-builder-js.js` | Refreshes `ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js` + CMS base CSS inc (does **not** fix Style Manager fonts) | ### Manual fix required (not covered by regen) | File | Issue | |---|---| | `CMS/Controls/3Landing/BanLanhDao/ban-lanh-dao-page-builder.js` | TiemChung Style Manager fonts; `tc-*` theme traits; vaccine-tab dead code | | `tools/generate-banlanhdao-builder-js.js` | Should patch Style Manager options to Lexend/Be Vietnam Pro and strip TiemChung theme traits on regen | ### Do not need changes for visual sync - `SectionBanLanhDao.ascx.cs` — load/sanitize logic is sound - `BanLanhDaoPageHandler.ashx.cs` — import/save/scoping validation OK - `scope-css.js` — working correctly - Web Forms pages (`SectionBanLanhDao.aspx`) — behavior preserved --- ## 6. Safest minimal sync approach (preserve Web Forms) 1. **Regenerate from canonical:** run `generate-banlanhdao-fullpage-seed.js` after any `output/style.css` / `Ban_Lanh_Dao.html` change. 2. **Reset DB content:** run `02_CMS_BanLanhDaoFullPage_Insert_NoiDungHienTai.sql` (creates new published version) — or CMS **Import frontend** from `/ban-lanh-dao/?cmsTemplate=1` then publish. 3. **Prefer import over block assembly:** do not rebuild page from CMS palette blocks (`bld-hero`, etc.) — stubs lack full content/styling. 4. **CssText strategy:** after regen, either (a) keep SQL seed full `CssText` as safety net if SSI fails, or (b) publish with **empty** `CssText` and rely on `.css.inc` only — but verify SSI works in deployment. Avoid Style Manager edits until fonts are fixed. 5. **Verify on HOS:** confirm `#ban-lanh-dao-page-base-style` contains scoped rules (not empty comment); confirm `#ban-lanh-dao-page-cms-style` is not injecting wrong partial overrides. 6. **Do not touch** ascx code-behind postback logic, `GetPublished` SP, or master page structure. --- ## 7. Quick diagnostic checklist (for live environment) Run `SQL/CHUYENDOI/BanLanhDao/02_CMS_BanLanhDaoFullPage_KiemTra.sql`: - `DoDaiCss` — 0 after CMS import-save means HOS depends on `.css.inc` only - `WrapperVi` — should be `OK` - Multiple published versions — latest may have GrapesJS overrides Browser devtools on `/ban-lanh-dao`: - Is `#ban-lanh-dao-page-base-style` populated? - Does `#ban-lanh-dao-page-cms-style` override hero colors? - Are Lexend/Be Vietnam Pro fonts loading? --- **Bottom line:** Repo-generated artifacts are aligned with canonical source. Visual differences come from **how CSS is split and loaded** (static inc vs DB overrides vs global HOS CSS) and **CMS builder TiemChung leftovers**, not from wrong seed HTML. Minimal fix = regen seed + republish canonical content + ensure base `.css.inc` loads + stop GrapesJS from writing conflicting `CssText`. [REDACTED]
